title: An empty Inactive tab says No inactive parts at this location.
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at a location that has no inactive parts at all, such as a newly created location.
  • Create an active part, part A, at that location for this test.
  • Start on that location's Inventory page, on the Active tab, with the Search box empty and Bin Location and Category set to All.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Inactive tab.
  2. Click the Active tab.
  3. Click the part A row.
  4. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  7. Click the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • In place of the list, the Inactive tab shows "No inactive parts at this location." and no rows.

Step 2:

  • The Active tab lists part A.

Step 3:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 4:

  • Inactive is picked under Part Status.

Step 5:

  • The "Deactivate part?" confirmation opens.

Step 6:

  • The window closes with a "Part deactivated." message, and part A leaves the Active tab.

Step 7:

  • The Inactive tab lists part A.
  • "No inactive parts at this location." is no longer shown.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10814 (Story 1, Active and Inactive Tabs on the Inventory List), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S1-N1: “If there are no inactive parts at the location and no search or filter is narrowing the list, the Inactive tab shows "No inactive parts at this location."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Inactive tab with no parts, nothing narrowing it | "No inactive parts at this location." | In place of the list”
  • S13-R21: “Picking a different status changes nothing until Save. When Save is pressed with a different status picked, the confirmation of Story 10 opens first.”
  • S13-R22: “Confirming saves every change in the dialog, then applies the status, and closes the dialog with "Part deactivated." or "Part activated.".”
